_comment: Four test fixtures for the AcadFlow M1+M2 phase. Paste these into the Form Trigger's Test panel (or POST as JSON to the webhook URL) to exercise every branch without burning many of the 1000 trial executions. Note: deadline_iso values are relative to 2026-06-04 (today). Adjust if you test on another date.

test_1_low_risk.Instructions: Write a 2-page (approx 800 words) personal reflection on one case study from Module 3 dealing with algorithmic bias. Cite at least 2 of the assigned readings. APA style. Submit as PDF to the LMS by the deadline. Rubric: Clarity of argument 40%, Use of course material 30%, Reflection depth 20%, Mechanics 10%.
test_1_low_risk.Current Progress / Notes: I have read the case study and started a bullet outline.

test_2_medium_risk.Instructions: Implement a simplified Raft consensus protocol in Go or Rust. Required: leader election, log replication, basic safety guarantees. Submit a single repo with a README, unit tests, and a 1-page design doc. Rubric: Correctness 40%, Test coverage 25%, Design doc clarity 20%, Code quality 15%. Must use Go 1.22+ or Rust 1.78+.

test_3_high_risk_urgent_override.Assignment Title: Group capstone — Industry analysis & growth strategy
test_3_high_risk_urgent_override.Instructions: 20-page industry analysis using Porter's Five Forces and PESTEL. Pick a public company, model 3 growth strategies with NPV projections (5-year horizon), recommend one. Include exec summary, methodology, financial model (Excel), and 10-slide deck. Cite 15+ peer-reviewed sources. Submit as a zip. Rubric: Analytical rigor 30%, Financial modeling 25%, Strategic insight 20%, Presentation quality 15%, Citations 10%.
test_3_high_risk_urgent_override.Current Progress / Notes: We have a company picked but nothing else.

_expected.classifier_risk_level: high (forced by urgent override even if model says medium)
